#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

class Solver {
public:
    Solver() {
        solve();
    }

    void solve() {
        long long n, m;
        std::cin >> n >> m;
        
        if (m < n) {
            long long temp = m;
            m = n;
            n = temp;
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            std::cout << brute1(m) << std::endl;
            return;
        }
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m < 3) std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
            else if (m == 3) std::cout << 4 << std::endl;
            else if (m == 7) std::cout << 12 << std::endl;
            else std::cout << 2 * m << std::endl;
            return;
        }

        long long total = n * m;
        if (total % 2 == 0) {
            std::cout << total << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << total - 1 << std::endl;
        }
    }

    long long brute1(long long m) {
        long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
        long long remainder = m % 6;
        if (remainder == 5) ans += 4;
        else if (remainder == 4) ans += 2;
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    try {
        Solver solver;
    } catch (const std::runtime_error& e) {
        if (std::string(e.what()) != "Clean exit") {
            throw;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
